summary: A large, imposing structure characterized by distinctive horizontal striped walls and two prominent front towers. The building has a fortress-like or monumental appearance with a mostly flat, multi-level roof and a symmetrical front facade.

shape.overall_form: Blocky and tiered with twin front towers
shape.symmetry: Bilateral symmetry along the front-to-back axis

rebuild_hints: Begin by constructing the two identical front towers to establish the scale and central axis of symmetry.
Pay close attention to the repeating horizontal stripe pattern on the main walls, alternating between wood, a white block, and a grey block.
The roof is not a single flat plane but consists of multiple flat sections at varying heights, utilizing a mix of wood planks and stone slabs.
uncertainties: The exact block type used for the white stripes (could be quartz, white concrete, or smooth stone).
The complete footprint and layout of the rear sections of the building, as they are partially obscured.
The interior layout and exact floor heights.
